driver.name: Freya Lindqvist
driver.bio: Rally-bred car control; at her best when the grip goes.
driver.background: From Värmland, Sweden; forest rallies and ice racing on frozen lakes until Cal Beaumont watched her slide a car across one and offered her a seat at Mojave.
driver.personality: Deadpan; says grip is overrated and means it; the rain specialist Tanabe's great rival; the one person at Mojave who has never been impressed by the barn.

style: Original fictional driver in GTA V loading-screen-inspired inked, cel-shaded illustration; no real driver likeness.
